69.feeder: IEEE 69-bus feeder (12.66 kV, 3.80 MW nominal load), 10 EVCSs

policy_training.seed_role: policy and reward-model initialization and training-day sampling; annotations are generated from each run's trajectories
policy_training.labeled_steps_per_run: 2400 (100 operating days x 24 steps; 60/20/20 days for fitting, early stopping, held-out evaluation)

service_constraint.scope: all methods, including the PSA baseline
service_constraint.form: end-of-day penalty sum_m mu_m * max(0, Delta_m - Delta_bar_m) / sigma_m, Delta_m in {waiting deficit, departure shortfall}
service_constraint.multiplier_update: dual ascent after every block of 20 episodes
service_constraint.normalized_excess: max(0, Delta_m - Delta_bar_m) / sigma_m; sigma_m = pooled within-preference standard deviation of the daily Delta_m over the first 500 training episodes
service_constraint.service_limits_met: share of held-out days on which both Delta_m are within their limits (Table III row)

reward_model.architecture: MLP with shared encoder, scalar head and semantic projection head
reward_model.optimizer: Adam, lr 1e-3, weight decay 1e-4, batch 64, early-stopping patience 100

split.mode: by operating day (all steps of a day in one subset)

annotator_comparison_fig11.note: separate single-seed experiment in its own scenario; checkpoints every 100 episodes evaluated on the eight development days with the main study's return definition and reporting scale; compared only within Fig. 11

psa_baseline.name: Price-Service Adaptive Reward (PSA)
psa_baseline.s_sys_definition: pooled within-profile standard deviation of the PSA daily score on the initialization data
psa_baseline.service: only through the shared service constraint above
psa_baseline.information: no LLM, operator evaluation, or preference information; identical training signal under V, S, C
psa_baseline.other_settings: same initialization, PPO settings, training-day pool, seeds, and 24 held-out days as the other policies

voltage.voltage_violation_rate: fraction of hours in which at least one bus leaves the band
voltage.figure13_reference_lines_meaning: voltage safety limits used for the reported voltage metrics
voltage.figure13_run: Semantic Reward, 33-bus voltage-first, seed 503, 10000 episodes; test day 3, reset identifier 2266002
voltage.figure13_selection: Among the violation-free days for the fixed policy, choose the day whose return is closest to the median return across all 24 test days.

battery_degradation.basis: LFP pack price 81 USD/kWh, 7.20 CNY/USD, 2,500 equivalent full cycles to 80% capacity, each cycle = charge-plus-discharge throughput of twice the capacity
battery_degradation.sensitivity_evaluation: purchase-plus-degradation cost at the nominal coefficient; 33-bus and 69-bus, 10,000 episodes, 24 held-out days

modes: retraining under each condition (Table VII, Fig. 9)

language_interface_study.parser: keyword parser (v0) and keyword parser with clarification fallback (v1)
